verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a self-hosted mode that runs entirely on your own servers, browsers, and LLM API keys, so your data need not pass through Skyvern's cloud. That indirectly keeps data out of vendor training, but the pack has no explicit no-training policy or opt-out control. missing for 10: explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a training opt-out control for the cloud product, data-usage/privacy policy documentation, independent corroboration
